dedupe_keys.name: run level simulation data for guardian effects in child evacuation

description: Hui Liu and colleagues publish run-level outputs for a cellular-automaton study of guardian effects in child evacuation. Zenodo provides a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The authors report 1,680 unique run records, with baseline and sensitivity conditions for a FREEZE-off intervention, partition ablation, escort timeout, occupancy and escort speed. The package is described as containing a data dictionary, processed analysis files and a reproduction script. These runs can benchmark how escort rules and guardian behaviour change clearance outcomes in child-evacuation models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this synthetic benchmark. A limitation is that the 1,830 stated replications reuse baseline runs, so those are not 1,830 independent observations. The public page does not identify a real school or measured calibration. The ZIP was not downloaded and the 1,680-record count and reproduced statistics were not checked.
